why: 'ποσοστιαία' is just a form of the lemma, not a separate family word

collocations.en: we grill meat on Smoky Thursday

why: 'ψητά την Τσικνοπέμπτη' is a fragment, not a collocation; replaced with the standard 'τσικνίζουμε'
'φραπεδιά' is doubtful as a family word
ράσο is the everyday cassock, not liturgical vestments
ενδιάμεσος is a synonym only of the secondary sense, not of 'median'
ισοπαλία is not from the same root (only shares ισο-)
ιατροδικαστής is not the same root; replaced with νεκροτομείο
μετάλλαξη is not the same root
αγανάκτηση (indignation) is not a near-synonym of revulsion

collocations.en: a solution that saves the day

why: main modern sense is 'saving/lifeline', 'salutary' is secondary; 'σωτήριο σχέδιο' is not the usual term for rescue plan (σχέδιο διάσωσης); ευεργετικός is not a near-synonym of the main sense

gloss: (έμψυχο δυναμικό) staff, personnel, human resources; animate, living
why: learners meet the fixed phrase έμψυχο δυναμικό far more often than the literal sense
εθελοντικά means 'as a volunteer', not 'of one's own accord'
'ευστοχώ στην επιλογή' is not a natural combination

gloss: (οι επιτήδειοι) crooks, swindlers, opportunists; crafty, skilful
why: the noun use (swindlers) is by far the most frequent in today's Greek
υποδειγματικός means 'model', not 'exemplary/deterrent' as in παραδειγματική τιμωρία

gloss: co-perpetration, joint commission of an offence (legal)

example.el: Ο δεύτερος κατηγορούμενος διώκεται για συναυτουργία σε ανθρωποκτονία.
example.en: The second defendant is being prosecuted as a co-perpetrator of homicide.

why: in Greek criminal law συναυτουργία (co-perpetration) is distinct from συνέργεια (complicity); gloss, example and synonym corrected
